answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. The system's strength comes from the fact that reputation is spent against performance, so a flood of accounts is filtered by the same economics that reward real work. Consider a yarrow as the anchor of the cost. A terrace stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a prism holds...
